title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: six-class (negation + GLV) parallel Pollard rho in G1, global work meter, truncated-product canonicalisation

claims.statement: For a uniform challenge T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1 (T=infinity returns 0), the algorithm in proof.md outputs x with success probability at least 0.39, and on every run its total work is at most 2^126.2055 batched-affine-G1-addition equivalents (C=2,000 instructions), enforced by a global work meter that charges every action at an upper-bound price before execution and halts with failure at 2^126.2055. Walk: 2^22 distinguished-point trails on (r-1)/6 six-classes, parity key, twisted table, doubling escape, global meter; success thresholds are the track minimum 0.39.

experiments.purpose: Part A: on BLS12-381 G1, check the GLV pair, orbit size 6 and unit action, the parity class key (one key on all six members, bit 0 zero, a bijection with |y| so the same classes), canonical member, the section-5 row-4/row-5 limb rule with limbs 0-2 (subs/sbcs borrow chain, ands, csel, ubfx, cbz and the table address 8h+4s+j at 256-byte entries) against the exact K mod 2^192, s, h, distinguished test and address on random, boundary and distinguished-key y, the section-1.1 truncated-product canonical index against the exact rule (random and adversarial near-tie inputs), the merged fallback branch of rows 2-3 run instruction by instruction with NZCV flags against the OR of the three section-1.1 tests, twisted-step identity, doubling class map, the multiplicative order of 2 mod r, table entries, coefficient tracking on production steps, and recovery of a planted x from two production trails forced to merge. Part B: run the per-trail algorithm of proof.md on a toy curve y^2=x^3+4 over F_q and report class visits to the first inter-trail collision against the random-mapping model and fruitless-cycle rates; pipeline=true also applies the scaled production rules (phase-1 budget, phase 2, report capacity, 8-match cap) and reports the success ratemd's section-6 sweep tables (the default 'parity' is the attack's key). Toy scale only. Optional canon_random/canon_stress set the number of section-1.1 checks; toy=false skips Part B. long_trails>0 runs the many-escapes-per-trail trap test (walks without distinguished points, long_len operations each, small R allowed), counting non-fruitless returns (across escapes or after more than 64 arrivals) separately from repeats inside detected fruitless cycles, against the self-collision expectation; long_escape_add=true runs the rejected additive escape as a control. The cost block prints section 5's ledger, the per-batch work and its share, the refresh price, the walk-record layout, its derived prices and the claim's success bounds at the declared fraction, with exact-fraction checks.
